solves.reasoning: harmful genes cause serious problems; temptations to upgrade normal genes to superior versions; pursuit for perfection is natural to human nature → harmful-upgrade-natural = ch[0]
proves to be safe and effective (not ineffective); upgrade to superior (not inferior) versions; giving beneficial (not detrimental) features → effective-superior-beneficial = ch[1]
it might seem logical, even preferable (not avoidable); certainly be temptations (not hesitations) to upgrade; pursuit for perfection (not imperfection) → preferable-temptations-perfection = ch[2]
④ impossible: passage original is 'earliest possible stage of life' — impossible contradicts the context of gene editing being achievable
② worsen disease-causing mutations: passage original is 'correct' (교정하다) — worsen is the opposite meaning
③ mediocrity: passage says 'The pursuit for perfection seems almost natural' — mediocrity (평범함) is the antonym of perfection
before _____ genes begin causing serious problems → harmful. ch: [harmful, normal, beneficial, physical]. harmful = ch[0] = ans 1

there will certainly be _____ to upgrade normal genes → temptations (유혹). ch: [characteristics, versions, mutations, temptations]. temptations = ch[3] = ans 4. NOTE: det.analysis has inverted ✅/❌ markers but stored ans=4 is correct.
this _____ slope → slippery (관용표현 slippery slope = 한번 시작하면 멈추기 어려운 상황). ch: [natural, logical, slippery, possible]. slippery = ch[2] = ans 3

effective = 효과적인 → best synonym: successful (성공적인, 원하는 결과를 내는). ch: [successful, sufficient, expensive, inefficient]. successful = ch[0] = ans 1. NOTE: det.analysis has inverted ✅/❌ markers — ✅ on inefficient (wrong) and ❌ on successful (right). Stored ans=1 is correct.
transform = 변환하다 → best synonym: convert (형태/성질을 바꾸다). ch: [preserve, transmit, transfer, convert]. convert = ch[3] = ans 4
lower = 낮추다 → best synonym: reduce (줄이다). ch: [increase, reduce, maintain, eliminate]. reduce = ch[1] = ans 2
beneficial(유익한) ↔ harmful(해로운). ch: [helpful, marginal, practical, harmful]. harmful = ch[3] = ans 4
preferable(바람직한) ↔ undesirable(바람직하지 않은). ch: [undesirable, desirable, favorable, optional]. undesirable = ch[0] = ans 1
(A) 'stage of life' = 단계(phase/시기); (B) actor walked onto the stage = 무대(platform). → (A)단계-(B)무대 = ch[1] = ans 2

'a change in the structure of a gene that can cause a different and sometimes harmful characteristic to develop' = mutation (돌연변이). ch: [evolution, adaptation, mutation, variation]. mutation = ch[2] = ans 3
disease-___(cause) = disease-causing (현재분사 복합형용사); begin ___(cause) = begin causing (동명사). 두 빈칸 모두 causing
bear(낳다) → born(과거분사) → unborn(태어나지 않은). 'in ___(bear) children' = 'in unborn children'
to correct _____ at the earliest possible stage → disease-causing mutations. ch: [physical characteristics, mental abilities, disease-causing mutations, slippery slope]. ans 3
_____ seems almost natural to human nature → The pursuit for perfection (완벽의 추구). ch[0] = ans 1
